summary: The HSPnetPagingSessionUserControl class is a .NET user control designed for handling paging functionality within a web application. It manages the page size settings through session variables and integrates with components like HSPnetGridView and HSPnetPager.
purpose: To provide paging control functionality by managing page sizes and storing these settings in session variables.

workflows.name: Setup Paging
steps: Set up paging when UserSession is assigned.

workflows.name: Save Paging Session Variable
steps: Store page size settings in session variables using TopPager, BottomPager, and GridView.

workflows.name: Toggle Paging
steps: Toggle paging settings using DefaultPageSize and MaxPageSize.

workflows.name: Init Paging From Session Variable
steps: Initialize paging settings from session variables and validate page sizes.

business_rules: Ensure defaultPageSize and maxPageSize are positive and defaultPageSize is less than or equal to maxPageSize.
validations: Check that defaultPageSize and maxPageSize are greater than zero and that defaultPageSize is not greater than maxPageSize.
conditions: If pageSize is greater than or equal to MaxPageSize, set to MaxPageSize.
Else if pageSize is less than MaxPageSize, set to DefaultPageSize.
system_behavior: Updates paging settings based on session variables.
Registers pager and grid view components for paging control.
